sentences.text:
2. The Petitioner is facing prosecution in Special Case No.262/27 of 2016 arising out of Town P.S.
Case No.64 of 2016 under Sections 376(2)(i) of I.P.C. read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act pending in the Court of learned Adhoc.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been enlarged on bail.

However, the Petitioner did not appear before the Court below on 18.12.2023 leading to issuance of NBW(A) against him.
4.

Learned counsel for the Petitioner on instruction from his client undertakes that his client would be appearing before the Court below on or before 7th March, 2024 and seeks appropriate remedy available to him under law.
5. Taking into consideration the above facts and submission at the Bar, the order dated 18.12.2023 passed by the learned Adhoc.

Additional District & Sessions Judge (FTSC), Keonjhar is set aside,
subject to the Petitioner paying cost of Rs.500/-(Rupees Five Hundred) to be deposited in the Orissa High Court Advocates' Welfare Fund.
